instruction: In the BoomerangSales spreadsheet, calculate the total quantity of all sales orders and put the result in cell G2.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to calculate revenue using VLOOKUP from Retail Price sheet. Added 'Revenue' header in H1 and tried writing a VLOOKUP formula in H2, but got #N/A error. Spent 40+ turns trying to fix the formula by clicking various cells and re-entering formulas, but never succeeded. No pivot table was created.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate between sheets, click on cells, type text headers and values, attempt formula entry. Demonstrated understanding of spreadsheet layout and column structure.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed at constructing a correct VLOOKUP formula. The #N/A error suggests incorrect range reference or column index. The model kept retrying the same broken approach rather than debugging the formula parameters.
metadata.task_rationale: Decomposed the original complex task (VLOOKUP + revenue calculation + pivot table) into a simple SUM formula task. SUM is much simpler than VLOOKUP and tests basic formula capability.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to compute total quantity using SUM(E2:E36)=780. Getter reads cell G2 value from the saved xlsx. Metric checks if value equals 780 within tolerance.

scoring_breakdown.cell_value: 1.0 - Correct total quantity (780) in cell G2

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads cell G2 from sheet 0 of BoomerangSales.xlsx, matching the instruction requirement.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_value') and expected.get('tolerance') from the rules dict.
Postconfig properly activates window and saves file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads, ensuring fresh data is available.
openpyxl with data_only=True will correctly read the cached formula result after LibreOffice saves.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (total quantity in G2) is fully verified by checking the numeric value with appropriate tolerance.
Expected value of 780 (SUM of quantity column E2:E36) is consistent with the task metadata explanation.
